svg.title: Social Feed — Distributed Cache
svg.desc: A read-heavy social feed uses cache-aside reads and database-first invalidation. Hits return from a healthy RAM replica; misses return through the Feed API and refill the cache.

text.tspan: HIT · FEED FROM RAM → FEED API
Low p99 · most reads end in RAM
Same 2 API hosts · rebuild CPU included
one database read per missing key
Duplicate reads wait and share result
BLUE request · GREEN cache answer · AMBER database
FEED READ · HIT FROM RAM · MISS TO FEED API
SHARDING · MORE SHARDS ADD CACHE RAM
REPLICATION · COPIES KEEP A SHARD AVAILABLE
WRITE POLICY · DATABASE FIRST → INVALIDATE → NEXT
